user.title: WeatherNext 3
user.description: Enter the location and the Google Cloud project where you linked the WeatherNext dataset from Analytics Hub.

data_description.dataset_id: The name you gave the dataset when subscribing to the WeatherNext listing in Analytics Hub.
data_description.table_id: weathernext_3_0_0_0p1deg for the ~10 km grid with all variables.
data_description.bq_location: Must match the region of the linked dataset (usually US).
data_description.service_account_json: Paste the full key file. It needs the BigQuery Job User and BigQuery Data Viewer roles.

error.invalid_service_account: The service account JSON is not valid.
error.table_not_found: Table not found. Check the project, dataset and region. Detail: {error_detail}
error.no_data: The query returned no forecast for those coordinates.
error.invalid_project: The project ID is not valid.
error.invalid_dataset: The dataset ID is not valid.
error.invalid_table: The table name is not valid.

abort.already_configured: A location is already configured at those coordinates.

data_description.horizon_hours: Up to 360 h (15 days). Fewer hours means less data read in BigQuery.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: The model updates hourly; querying more often adds nothing and burns quota.
data_description.lookback_hours: How far back to look for model runs. Hourly runs reach 48 h and 6-hourly runs reach 360 h, so cover at least one long run.
